title: Extended Cyber Kill Chain for AI-Era Threats
description: A defender-side extension of the Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain for LLM and agentic AI threats. Adds a model supply chain compromise pre-attack stage (Stage 0), AI-specific sub-techniques across the original seven stages, and a split of Actions on Objectives into classical data exfiltration, model extraction, and agentic pivot. Includes mappings to MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
